invariants.rule: first target write must-not occur before durable backups and PREPARED journal file+directory fsync
invariants.positive_case: durable transaction id exists before the first target mutation
invariants.negative_case: a crash occurs after a target write with no durable journal

invariants.rule: unapply must-not delete CAS/hash-mismatched user content
invariants.positive_case: user-modified content is preserved and reported as an ownership conflict
invariants.negative_case: unapply deletes or restores over a user edit

invariants.positive_case: write syscall spy remains at zero for every read-only operation
invariants.negative_case: status creates a lock, migration, backup, temp file, or repaired state

invariants.rule: adopted/project-owned Template content must-not be treated as created Extension content
invariants.positive_case: unapply removes ownership metadata while retaining adopted or project-owned content
invariants.negative_case: an adopted or project-owned Template file is deleted as Extension-created

invariants.rule: every target mutation must revalidate target/ancestor identity and node CAS at use time
invariants.positive_case: symlink swap, target replacement and path race are rejected before mutation
invariants.negative_case: a preflight realpath passes and a later write escapes or overwrites changed state

invariants.rule: config unapply must preserve missing/null/value, stable list identity and unrelated edits
invariants.positive_case: exact owned nodes restore while unrelated text and adopted equal values remain
invariants.negative_case: marker, list index or whole-file restore loses user data

invariants.rule: Guru official-install wrapper must preflight and stage exact 0.6.7 output, verify content postconditions and convert raw rc0 blank fallback or cleanup failure to nonzero without target pollution
invariants.positive_case: current HTTPS ref stages exact Template, cleanup succeeds, then WAL publishes project assertions and Extension nodes
invariants.negative_case: raw rc0, blank/mismatched stage, stale ref or failed cleanup is treated as success or mutates the real target
invariants.route_if_missing: unchanged target or committed cleanup_required; block release
